overview: The Medford City Council approved a reduced FY 2027 municipal budget, implementing targeted cuts to the law department until requested legal expenditure records are provided. The Council also approved several major free cash appropriations, local preservation grants, and a new special education reserve fund.

items.title: Resolution Celebrating Marie Cassidy
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution congratulating Marie Cassidy on her retirement and celebrating her 33 years of service to the Medford Family Network.

items.title: Committee Records and Reports
items.summary: The Council approved several committee records and reports from June 9th and June 11th, including amendments to minor clerical errors.

items.title: Resolution on Rent Stabilization Campaign
items.summary: A resolution supporting rent stabilization compromise efforts was withdrawn by its sponsors.

items.title: Special Education Reserve Fund Resolution
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution establishing a special education reserve fund to manage volatile special education expenditures for Medford Public Schools.

items.title: Free Cash and Retained Earnings Appropriations
items.summary: The Council approved the appropriation of $10,099,270.04 from free cash and $560,000 in retained earnings for capital stabilization, snow and ice deficits, union retro payments, and a high school feasibility study.

items.title: Main Street Corridor Easements and Takings
items.summary: The Council tabled proposed orders to acquire easements and alter road layouts along the Main Street and Mystic Avenue Corridor to allow further public consultation before July 14th.

items.title: Resolution to Appeal Deficient Public Records Response
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution to appeal the administration's legal spending public records response to the Secretary of State's Public Records Division.

items.title: Resolution to Prepare 1/12th Budget
items.summary: A resolution to reject the mayor's budget in favor of a month-to-month 1/12th budget failed.

items.title: Affordable Housing Trust & Medford Family Network Funding
items.summary: The Council approved free cash appropriations of $250,000 for the Affordable Housing Trust and $100,000 to bridge a grant funding gap for the Medford Family Network.

items.title: Food Truck Permits
items.summary: The Council approved food truck permits for Tandor, Curry and Revelry for summer events in Medford Square.

items.title: Community Preservation Committee Appropriations
items.summary: The Council approved Community Preservation Act grants of $38,000 for perimeter wall repairs at the Royal House and $70,000 for ADA improvements at Shiloh Baptist Church.

items.title: Curtis Tufts High School Assessment Funding
items.summary: An appropriation of $17,500 from the Capital Stabilization Fund was approved to assess the capital needs and future use of Curtis Tufts High School.

items.title: Health and Human Services Personnel Ordinance Amendments
items.summary: The Council approved on first reading changes to classification and titles within the health department, renaming it to the Department of Health and Human Services.

items.title: Supplemental FY 2027 Budget Appropriations
items.summary: The Council approved a supplemental municipal appropriation of $112,929 to fund various legislative, executive, recreation, and library salaries.

items.title: FY 2027 General Fund Budget Approval
items.summary: The Council voted to reduce the law department budget by 83% and subsequently approved the revised FY 2027 General Fund Budget as reduced.

items.title: Non-Union Personnel Wage Adjustment
items.summary: The Council approved the non-union personnel ordinance wage adjustment on third reading.
